Class ClientHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.server.ClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
ModelObserver
Direct Known Subclasses:
ClientHandlerRmi, ClientHandlerSocket
public abstract class ClientHandler extends Object implements ModelObserver
Abstract base class for server-side client handlers.

Centralizes shared state between RMI and Socket implementations:

  • Player nickname
  • ClientMessageVisitor for routing incoming messages
  • Idempotent disconnection flag and handling
  • Single-threaded executor for serialized outgoing callbacks

sendAsync(CheckedRunnable) is the design's core pattern, encapsulating: availability check, executor submission, and transport error handling. This avoids repetition across subclass callback methods.

Subclasses must implement:

  • startHealthCheck() — transport-specific ping mechanism
  • handleTransportError(Exception) — handle network errors
and may override tryMarkDisconnected() for additional cleanup (e.g., closing executors or streams).

    • tryMarkDisconnected

      protected boolean tryMarkDisconnected()
      Marks the handler as disconnected in an idempotent manner and shuts down the messageSender.

      Subclasses owning additional executors or resources must override this method, call super.tryMarkDisconnected() first, and proceed only if it returns true: 

      @Override
protected synchronized boolean tryMarkDisconnected() {
    if (!super.tryMarkDisconnected()) return false;
    myExecutor.shutdownNow();
    return true;
}
      Returns:
      true if this thread was first to mark disconnection; false if already disconnected

    • sendAsync

      protected final void sendAsync(ClientHandler.CheckedRunnable action)
      Sends a callback to the client asynchronously and thread-safely.

      Encapsulates the common pattern: check availability, submit to executor, catch transport errors. This avoids boilerplate in every callback method.

      Usage in a subclass: 

      public void onEvent(EventDTO e) {
    sendAsync(() -> clientStub.onEvent(e));  // RMI
    // or:
    sendAsync(() -> out.writeObject(new EventMessage(e)));  // Socket
}
      Parameters:
      action - the send action; may throw any Exception

    • startHealthCheck

      protected abstract void startHealthCheck()
      Starts the transport-specific health check thread.

      Called by subclass constructors after initializing network resources (e.g., RMI stubs, socket streams).

    • handleTransportError

      protected abstract void handleTransportError(Exception e)
      Handles a transport error during asynchronous send.

      Typically marks the client as disconnected and notifies the appropriate listener (e.g., DisconnectionListener, MatchManager).

      Parameters:
      e - the exception (RemoteException for RMI, IOException for socket)
